notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.5 is finally here! ːsteamhappyː

Mirabel
- "Heal" can now be obtained at Level 18 (instead of Level 20 previously).
- "Revive" can now be obtained at Level 42 (instead of Level 45 previously).

Remy
- "Thief Dance" can now be obtained at Level 30 (instead of Level 32 previously).

Other Things
- More "personalization" for the 3 companions' interactions at the Inn.
- Gold-digger event - interaction added.
- Extra Sound Effects added for various events, including the four animals' encounters.

Best Regards.

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.4 is now live.

- A new look for "Hero Village".
- Epilogue stories were added for the 4 main characters.
- Updated texts for a few NPCs.
- A few extra hints added.
- Mirabel's "Holy Attack" can now be obtained at Level 28 (instead of Level 30 previously).
- Enemies' and Bosses' attributes were adjusted for a better balance.
- The probability of encountering a group of 3 enemies inside the "Deadly Volcanoes" was slightly increased.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/7c153f3f1d8033ed530549b19e594c395e365bcf.png

That's all for now. Have fun, adventurers! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.3 is now live.

Added Battlebacks
- More battle backgrounds have been added to the game.
- Specifically, we've updated the battlebacks for bosses' fights to become more "dramatic" (than the original game version / previous patches).

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/f9d62b2a6f9b979587c9ba9d1a4167c1c0e6a029.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/7d4d905d8b1ea5ba91db485faa0cc146b48622c2.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/f83f7bf49b23888a5dd56c3dc365be036e035d2e.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/71e40ab61fbf3e03baeab007a71e9c44874de8d4.png

We hope you like it! ːsteamhappyː

Game Mechanics
- Phoenix Down: Now revives an ally at 50% (instead of 40% previously).
- Remy's "Little Prayer" skill: Now recovers an ally's HP by 30% (instead of 25% previously).
- Mirabel's "Heal" skill: Now recovers 8 more (absolute) HP points than previously.
- Mirabel's "Heal All" skill: Now recovers all allies' HP by 55% (instead of 50% previously).
- Mirabel's "Revive" skill: Now revives an ally at 60% (instead of 50% previously).

That's all for now. Have fun, adventurers!

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.2 is finally here! ːsteamhappyː

After receiving several feedbacks from our testers, players, and reviewers, we have made the following changes / improvements in the game:

Grinding
- Was originally thought to be more on the "heavy" side; but...
- Is now made slightly easier (by roughly around 5-15%).
- This means = You will get more EXP & Gils every time you defeat an enemy.

Added Map
- You suggested that maybe we add a little bit more to the World Map?; so...
- We did!
- You now have = 1 additional place you can visit (to unlock some of the newly added achievements).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/3a7bc05ba6f4f9d00694db6d0f347e9a3f36b009.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/150897b4dbb12223d8d5d4c642f7e5aa34660c57.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/386673055c8c311e1af0065e3f55671910853443.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30207791/39bec7703e5a4b8c9a837875a0559d02dd433489.jpg

Achievements
- You wanted us to add some more achievements?; so...
- We did!
- You now have = 24 extra bonus achievements.
